title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Ambiguous final tile emptiness handling
description: The phrase 'except the non-empty final tile may be shorter' is ambiguous. It is unclear whether: (a) a final tile must always be non-empty, or (b) when the final tile happens to be non-empty, it may be shorter. The edge case of a packet whose compressed size is an exact multiple of 187 bytes (empty final tile) is not addressed.
